model.cost: Exact singleton-stopping bucket operations; LNS equations (2)-(3)

claim.conclusion: There exists an ambient dense G_delta R subset of (0,1), consisting of irrational nonboundary first-order-profile continuity ranks, such that for every t in R and every deterministic real center sequence c_n the scaled cost is not tight.
claim.quantitative_tail: For every finite L >= 0 and every deterministic c_n, limsup_n P(|Y_n(floor(n*t)+1)-c_n| > L*sqrt(n)) >= 1/4 for t in R.

mechanisms.exact_cost_control: Uniform empirical-CDF grid and collision events give a simultaneous deterministic error R_n with R_n/n -> 0 on events of probability -> 1.
mechanisms.jump_density: Every nonempty cylinder word W has jump +/-pi(W); root split cancels. Internal splits are dense.
mechanisms.boundary_limit: At every chosen jump boundary, Y_n/n converges to two unequal atoms each of probability 1/2, by direct cost control and the binomial CLT.
mechanisms.uniform_concentration: Separated fixed bands imply limsup of the supremum over moving real centers <= 1/2 for any fixed sqrt-scale radius.
mechanisms.topology: Rank-cell identity transfers boundary concentration failure to an open subset of X. Closed E_{M,N} are nowhere dense, so their countable-union complement is ambient dense G_delta.
mechanisms.quantifiers: Every radius has arbitrarily late violations uniformly over all centers. No uncountable union over centering sequences is used.

root_independent_reconstruction: Direct simultaneous cost bound is o_P(n); nonroot jump +/-pi(W) dense; fixed-boundary mixture has equal unequal atoms; all-center concentration<=1/2; exact half-open rank-cell equality supplies open failure sets; Baire complement is ambient dense G_delta; universal-center tail bound holds at arbitrarily late indices for every radius.
